inputs.text: This is a managed consent campaign, not neutral reporting. The emphasis on civilian areas and threatened infrastructure makes escalation feel unavoidable, while “just war” supplies a ready-made excuse for those in power. They’re not merely warning the public about a wider conflict—they’re conditioning people to accept it, then presenting the outcome as something nobody could have stopped. The framing is the tell: someone wants the public focused on inevitability instead of who benefits from pushing events there.
